name: Hot Pockets Hickory Ham & Cheddar (Crispy Buttery Crust)
whyItWorks: Unlike spicy pepperoni Hot Pockets, the Hickory Ham & Cheddar variety uses tender diced cured ham and mild cheddar cheese sauce wrapped in a flaky crust. It contains zero seeds, zero chili peppers, and zero tomato acid.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave in crisping sleeve for 2 minutes. Let cool for 2 minutes so hot cheese does not burn oral mucosa.
watchOuts: Contains cheese sauce (lactose); take a lactase enzyme tablet if sensitive.
